stage0032_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$セイナ$$
「$$五飛$$... why did you reveal to $$ミスリル$$
　that our hideout's in Odaiba?」

stage0032_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$五飛$$
「I completed the mission to abduct the two women.
　You have no grounds for complaint.」

stage0032_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$五飛$$
「Besides, once you two start fighting, they'll come.
　I merely saved you the trouble.」

stage0032_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$セイナ$$
「I'm not blaming you.
　We never intended to win, after all.」

stage0032_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$五飛$$
「...I was reminded of something a man once said...」

stage0032_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$セイナ$$
「It's fine.
　You don't have to force yourself to stay with us.」

stage0032_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$五飛$$
「I'm doing this because I choose to.
　I don't need your commentary.」

stage0032_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$大河内$$
「...So they're soldiers with nowhere left to go, I hear.」

stage0032_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$神村$$
「That's what $$佐伯$$'s report says, but...」

stage0032_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$大河内$$
「Soldiers who lost their reason to fight,
　and civilians who know theirs...」

stage0032_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$レイアム$$
「A21 has already deployed its forces over a wide area.」

stage0032_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$オットー$$
「Destroying the city at random,
　that's a terrorist's tactic, in the end.」

stage0032_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$リディ$$
「Those guys... not thinking about tactics at all?」

stage0032_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$マオ$$
「So they're ready to die burning the city down?」

stage0032_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Damn it!
　Guys who snap always take it to extremes!」

stage0032_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ルカ$$
「But with us here now,
　it seems the enemy's shifted to defense.」

stage0032_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$カツ$$
「Even dragging this out into a war of attrition,
　it's not like they've got a chance...!」

stage0032_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are they waiting for something...?」

stage0032_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$オズマ$$
「The rescue of $$千鳥かなめ$$ and Captain Testarossa
　goes to $$宗介$$ and $$ヒイロ$$.」

stage0032_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$アルト$$
「Captain Testarossa...
　captain of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$,
　and $$宗介$$'s superior officer, huh.」

stage0032_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Probably a dignified female captain,
　like XO $$レイアム$$.」

stage0032_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$n
「What is it, $$クルツ$$?
　That laugh of yours...」

stage0032_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$マオ$$
（We really ought to rescue $$テッサ$$
　and shove it in those kids' faces.）

stage0032_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's enough chit-chat.
　We suppress A21, and fast.」

stage0032_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$赤木$$
「I've heard the gist of it.」

stage0032_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$カレン$$
「If $$五飛$$'s right, and this fight is
　$$ルルーシュ$$'s... $$ゼロ$$'s fault...」

stage0032_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$青山$$
「That's why you sortied, isn't it,
　to prove it isn't?」

stage0032_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$いぶき$$
「That's right, $$カレン$$.
　Besides, here you are,
　fighting right alongside us.」

stage0032_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$赤木$$
「If that big forehead guy were right,
　you'd be the first one to turn terrorist, no?」

stage0032_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$赤木$$
「Let's go, $$カレン$$!
　This Odaiba's got $$２１世紀警備保障$$!
　Let the terrorists run wild, we lose the company!」

stage0032_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's go, $$赤木$$!
　Gotta give it our all for Earth's peace
　and $$２１世紀警備保障$$!」

stage0032_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$青山$$
「When the company's in crisis,
　a salaryman's just got to step up!」

stage0032_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$いぶき$$
「$$大山$$ and the others are out in the city,
　guiding people who couldn't flee in time!」

stage0032_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$赤木$$
「Let's do this, everyone!
　We're protecting Odaiba!!」

stage0032_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ボビー$$
「Well, we got off with minimal damage, somehow.」

stage0032_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Stay sharp.
　The enemy should have Lambda Driver types.」

stage0032_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$デュオ$$
「C'mon.
　If we can't save the hostages, that's a loss for us.」

stage0032_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$デュオ$$
「C'mon.
　If we can't save the hostages, that's a loss for us.」

stage0032_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
High-Performance AI
「$$ベヘモス$$ startup preparations.
　Please activate the Lambda Driver.」

stage0032_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$タクマ$$
「Here I go...
　Watch closely... this'll make you happy, Sis?」

stage0032_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
High-Performance AI
「Lambda Driver,
　First Function, activation confirmed.」

stage0032_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That's an AS, at that size!?」

stage0032_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$マオ$$, $$クルツ$$!
　Under that red robot's feet!」

stage0032_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$シン$$
「What is that, a pickup truck!?」

stage0032_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Look!
　$$宗介$$ and the others are riding it!」

stage0032_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$かなめ$$
「This is as far as it goes!」

stage0032_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$宗介$$
「Hurry, drive, $$ヒイロ$$!
　They're coming after us!」

stage0032_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Even $$マリーメイア$$'s army has come out!」

stage0032_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Damn it!
　They dropped this many Mobile Suits
　into the atmosphere!」

stage0032_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Here we go...!
　Hold on tight!」

stage0032_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$タクマ$$
「I won't let you get away, Testarossa!」

stage0032_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$赤木$$
「Like hell I'm letting go, you bastard!」

stage0032_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That's reckless, $$赤木$$!
　That thing's probably got a Lambda Driver,
　same as the Arbalest!」

stage0032_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$マオ$$
「In short, it turns human willpower into power!」

stage0032_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$赤木$$
「Then $$ダイ・ガード$$'s just the same!」

stage0032_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$赤木$$
「We're the same way!
　Our... PR Section 2's guts and grit
　give $$ダイ・ガード$$ its power!!」

stage0032_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$赤木$$
「Let's do this!
　Even salarymen can protect the peace!!」

stage0032_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$タクマ$$
「This guy...!
　Isn't he a soldier!?」

stage0032_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Rather than soldiers turning terrorist,
　salarymen playing the good guy
　does the world a lot more good!」

stage0032_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$墨田$$
「Don't you lose, $$赤木$$!
　Odaiba's peace is riding on you!」

stage0032_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$赤木$$
「Right!
　Let's give it everything we've got!!」

stage0032_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$いぶき$$
「$$ヒイロ$$!　While you still can!!」

stage0032_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$セイナ$$
「I won't let you get away!」

stage0032_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$葵$$
「No good!
　There's more enemy up ahead too!!」

stage0032_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$大山$$
「$$ヒイロ$$!
　Turn that corner, the AS can't follow!」

stage0032_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$横沢$$
「Straight ahead!
　Left lane's under construction, watch it!」

stage0032_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$田口$$
「Streetlight's broken, but no obstacles, you're fine!
　Punch it!」

stage0032_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$中原$$
「Hang in there, $$ヒイロ$$!
　Just a little more and you'll lose them!」

stage0032_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$大杉$$
「Once you get that far, you should be fine.」

stage0032_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$佐伯$$
「Everyone from PR Section 2, please withdraw!」

stage0032_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Launch Sergeant Sagara and $$ヒイロ$$'s units to that spot!」

stage0032_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$いぶき$$
「$$赤木$$!
　$$宗介$$ and $$ヒイロ$$ boarded their units too!」

stage0032_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$青山$$
「$$ダイ・ガード$$'s output is at its limit!
　Fall back for now!」

stage0032_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥かなめ$$, where's the Captain?」

stage0032_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$かなめ$$
「She's fine!
　Just passed out from the rough driving, I think!」

stage0032_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If not for your help,
　we'd have been finished.」

stage0032_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$赤木$$
「Didn't expect thanks from the silent duo.」

stage0032_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$青山$$
「Add $$キリコ$$, that's a trio,
　add $n, that's a quartet, if you like.」

stage0032_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$タクマ$$
「That white AS, you're $$相良宗介$$!
　If you've come out, this Beh...」

stage0032_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$宗介$$
「Licking your lips over your prey...
　That's what a third-rater does」

stage0032_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'll take you on.
　Come at me!」

stage0032_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All units, focus fire on that giant AS!
　Take it down and the enemy folds!」

stage0032_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$五飛$$
「Here I come, $$ヒイロ$$!
　I'll show you what false peace breeds!」

stage0032_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$タクマ$$
「Not yet!
　I can still fight!!」

stage0032_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$桂$$
「What's going on!
　Is that guy still not done!?」

stage0032_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I can't believe it!
　The unit's long past its limits already!」

stage0032_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$テッサ$$
（That's... probably the Lambda Driver,
　forcing the unit to keep moving）

stage0032_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$テッサ$$
（$$かなめ$$, please!
　Tell him!
　Use the Lambda Driver on $$ベヘモス$$'s cooling system...!）

stage0032_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$... Keep your phone on you...!」

stage0032_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$, can you hear me!?」

stage0032_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Um, listen carefully!
　I don't know why, but that giant AS apparently has
　a Lambda Driver cooling system near its leg's base!」

stage0032_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's all I know!
　And a normal attack won't cut it!」

stage0032_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Y-yeah... probably!
　Let's just go with that!」

stage0032_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$宗介$$
「What kind of half-baked answer is that...!」

stage0032_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$宗介$$, trust that woman.
　Remember the Hanka Autonomous Region.」

stage0032_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It's a long, narrow slit!
　Either side's fine, left or right!」

stage0032_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$タクマ$$
「No way...!
　$$ベヘモス$$, brought down by this!!」

stage0032_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
High-Performance AI
「Lambda Driver function halted.
　No possibility of recovery.」

stage0032_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$タクマ$$
「No way!
　At this rate, sis's wish...!」

stage0032_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
High-Performance AI
「$$ベヘモス$$ will be purged due to excess weight.」

stage0032_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Our fight ends here, it seems...」

stage0032_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$クガヤマ・タクマ$$...
　I won't forget your fight.」

stage0032_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$ヒイロ$$...!
　My fight isn't over yet!」

stage0032_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$マオ$$
「Good work, $$宗介$$.
　You did well.」

stage0032_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Hey, $$かなめ$$!
　How's $$テッサ$$ doing?」

stage0032_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「She's fine.
　Looks like she's just asleep.」

stage0032_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$リディ$$
「No way!
　However you look at it, she's still a teenager!」

stage0032_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「A genius beauty as captain...
　It's like something out of a manga...」

stage0032_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$マオ$$
「All right, all right, boys.
　Our $$姫$$ is resting.
　Don't make such a racket.」

stage0032_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$マオ$$
「Whoa there!
　Snapping a photo of her sleeping face
　won't slide past Boss $$マオ$$ here!」

stage0032_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$宗介$$
（Good...
　Chidori and the Colonel are both safe.）

stage0032_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Looks like there's no more fighting left, at least.」

stage0032_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$青山$$
「So the long night's finally over...
　Here's hoping we get night-shift pay.」

stage0032_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$赤木$$
「We managed to protect Odaiba.
　Just this once, unpaid overtime's fine by me.」

stage0032_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$カレン$$
「Mr. $$赤木$$...
　PR Section 2 really are heroes of justice.」

stage0032_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$赤木$$
「What's with you, $$カレン$$?
　Saying something so obvious.」

stage0032_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$カレン$$
（What $$ゼロ$$ taught the Black Knights
　wasn't only how to fight...）

stage0032_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$カレン$$
（To fight for what you believe in, for what
　you want to protect... and for pride, too...）

stage0032_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$カレン$$
（A21...
　You never found that, did you...）

stage0032_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$カレン$$
（But I'm different...
　I'm still fighting for what I want to protect.）

stage0032_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$カレン$$
（I bet $$ゼロ$$... $$ルルーシュ$$, too, is the same...
　So I bet... we'll meet again...）

stage0032_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Ngh! Is this as far as we go!」

stage0032_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$セイナ$$
「$$タクマ$$, you must keep fighting!
　To show this world that we lived!!」

stage0032_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$エマ$$
「Is that the Lambda Driver's power too!?」

stage0032_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$タクマ$$
「I'll do it, sis...!
　I'll fight to the very end!
　Just like you wanted!!」

stage0032_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$タクマ$$
「So please, sis!
　Don't abandon me!!」

stage0032_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$五飛$$
「Not yet!
　My fight still isn't over!」

stage0032_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$ヒイロ$$!
　The false peace will crumble soon!
　I'll settle things with you then, too!」

stage0032_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$張五飛$$...
　Why would a man like you...」

stage0032_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Didn't think he'd be this stubborn...
　Guess we'll have to stop him by force.」

stage0032_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$赤木$$
「This Odaiba isn't just home to $$２１世紀警備保障$$,
　it's a precious town to all kinds of people!」

stage0032_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$赤木$$
「If you're gonna try and wreck it,
　you'll have to get through $$２１世紀警備保障$$
　PR Section 2 and $$ダイ・ガード$$ first!!」

stage0032_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$カレン$$
「A fight that torches a city at random like this
　isn't what the Black Knights fight for!」

stage0032_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$カレン$$
「Wake up, A21!
　You and I didn't risk our lives fighting
　just to end up with a future like this!!」

stage0032_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$タクマ$$
「$$相良宗介$$!
　You've got some nerve, after what you pulled!」

stage0032_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$宗介$$
「What's wrong, third-rater?
　Want another beating with words before the bullets?」

stage0032_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$タクマ$$
「I won't lose a war of words
　to a silent type like you!」

stage0032_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$宗介$$
「Taking the bait, flying into a rage so easily...
　That's the proof of your third-rate nature...!」

stage0032_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$宗介$$
「Don't think small fry relying on a Lambda Driver
　can beat a professional soldier...!
　I'll beat that rotten attitude out of you!」

stage0032_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$宗介$$
「Seems you're the one who won't listen...!」

stage0032_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$五飛$$
「A $$ミスリル$$ soldier...!
　You don't seem to realize your own fight
　is leading you to your own ruin!」

stage0032_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$五飛$$
「When you learn what waits
　at the end of that path, you'll despair...!」

stage0032_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$宗介$$
「Then I'll defeat you
　and see for myself what's there!」

stage0032_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$タクマ$$
「A pure white-winged angel challenging
　the giant $$ベヘモス$$ amid crimson flames...!
　How lovely, don't you think, sis!」

stage0032_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I am no angel.
　Just a human, same as you.」

stage0032_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Until you realize that,
　you'll never break free of the cycle of war.」

stage0032_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Press self-destruct, $$五飛$$.
　End your own fight, by your own hand.」

stage0032_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$五飛$$
「My fight will not end...!
　Not until the world changes...!」

stage0032_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$五飛$$
「Look to the future through Zero, $$ヒイロ$$!
　This world's end is eternal war!」

stage0032_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So you're trapped in that eternity, $$五飛$$...!」

stage0032_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$タクマ$$
「Captain Kozuki!
　Even you can't stand a chance
　against this $$ベヘモス$$!」

stage0032_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$タクマ$$
「Sour grapes, even now!?
　Where'd your Japanese pride go!?」

stage0032_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$カレン$$
「You're the ones who lost your pride!
　The Black Knights fought for freedom and peace!」

stage0032_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$タクマ$$
「That world of freedom and peace
　is what shut us... shut A21 out!」

stage0032_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$カレン$$
「No!
　You're the ones who turned your backs on society!」

stage0032_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$カレン$$
「A new world has a new way to live!
　Why didn't you even try to find it!?」

stage0032_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$カレン$$
「If fighting's all you can do, join the military!
　Find your own fight to wage, like
　everyone at $$２１世紀警備保障$$ has!」

stage0032_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$カレン$$
「What you're trying to do is misplaced revenge!」

stage0032_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$タクマ$$
「Shut up!
　This blaze is what my sister wanted!
　That's why I have to!」

stage0032_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$カレン$$
「That's not good enough, $$タクマ$$!
　Not a fight someone else handed you,
　find your own, a reason to live!!」

stage0032_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$五飛$$
「Look at this, $$カレン$$!
　This is the end result of $$ゼロ$$'s world!」

stage0032_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$五飛$$
「He staked his life on it, and still the world didn't change!
　So soldiers have no choice but to fight forever!」

stage0032_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$カレン$$
「Don't spout your selfish logic!
　Every Black Knight I know
　has found a new life of their own!」

stage0032_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$扇$$ went back to teaching for the baby on the way,
　and Tamaki runs a small cafe of his own now!
　Same for Minami, Sugiyama, and Toudou's group!」

stage0032_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$カレン$$
「Just because you couldn't do that,
　doesn't mean you get to wreck others' happiness!」

stage0032_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$五飛$$
「Then stop them yourself!
　In $$ゼロ$$'s place, show me you can end
　the Black Knights' fight once and for all!」

stage0032_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$カレン$$
「You don't need to tell me that!
　My soul still stands with the Black Knights!!」

stage0032_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Guren...!
　So $$紅月カレン$$ has come!」

stage0032_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
Kallen
「That's right!
　$$紅月カレン$$ of the Black Knights will stop you!」

stage0032_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$セイナ$$
「That strength, with no hesitation...
　That's what we've always admired...」

stage0032_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$カレン$$
「Don't be ridiculous!
　No one is ever free of doubt!」

stage0032_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$カレン$$
「I doubt, I struggle, and still I keep thinking...!
　That's how I've become who I am today!
　With the Black Knights' pride, who fought for freedom and peace!」

stage0032_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$セイナ$$
「I'm glad our last battle is against you...
　Fighting alongside people like you all this time,
　I can say with pride it wasn't a mistake...」

stage0032_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$カレン$$
「Don't talk like this is already over!
　You're going to live and make amends for this!!」

stage0032_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$赤木$$
「So you're the leader of this group!
　Put a stop to this fight, now!」

stage0032_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Not a chance.
　Once we've started running, we won't stop till we fall...」

stage0032_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$セイナ$$
「If you want to protect the city, use force,
　hot-blooded salaryman」

stage0032_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$赤木$$
「If you've got that much strength to spare,
　why not fight for something else!」

stage0032_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$赤木$$
「The whole world's swamped right now,
　short-handed everywhere, and even $$２１世紀警備保障$$
　is always hiring part-timers!」

stage0032_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$赤木$$
「Sweating it out, working hard,
　isn't that a real fight to live too!!」

stage0032_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$セイナ$$
「...Yeah...
　That living is a fight too... he used to say that」

stage0032_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Maybe we'd forgotten that somewhere along the way...
　But it's too late for everything now...」
